name: ncc-workflow
description: Novel Create Center：长篇网文从立书到收束的工作流——书魂与类型契约、五层决策、三本账（承诺/知情/世界）、读者此刻、水章判据、八域审稿与修订闭环、开篇盲评与签约点、拆书喂设定库；每个决策点给推荐与备选，新手一句话也能开书。经理窗口调度九个创作角色，book.json 单一状态源，写-审-改分离。

description_i18n.en: Novel Create Center: a long-form web-novel workflow from founding to finale — book soul and genre contract, five decision layers, three ledgers (promises / knowledge states / world), a reader-now block per chapter, water-chapter detection, eight-domain review with revision loop, blind-read opening with signing points, and book deconstruction feeding the setting vault. Every decision point offers a recommendation and alternatives. A manager window dispatches nine creative roles over a single book.json state source, with write/review/revise separated.
